portal: Tracking / login area on messinaline.it (not logged in during this research)
sanctions_note: Not found as a named entry on OFAC SDN (9 Nov 2026) or the EU list downloaded 10 Nov 2026. Do not assume a current Bandar Abbas call based on 2022 third-party posts.

name: FESCO Transportation Group
ports: Public 2016-era news (still on the site when fetched) describes a FESCO Russia Iran Service via Anzali and onward Russian ports (Olya/Astrakhan in the announcement).
lanes: Caspian intermodal service between Iran (Anzali) and Russia, as described in FESCO's own press material. Confirm whether the service is still operating before any operational use.
services: Container transportation and logistics; intermodal Caspian service as announced by FESCO; tracking and quotes on the English site
portal: Tracking and quote language on https://www.fesco.com/en/
sanctions_note: Not found as a named entry on OFAC SDN (9 Nov 2026 file). Far-Eastern Shipping Company / FESCO appears on the EU consolidated list (Ukraine-related listings, including a 23 Oct 2025 amendment). High risk for EU persons. Check current status before any commercial use.
source: https://www.fesco.com/en/ ; FESCO press page on the Caspian Iran service; EU consolidated list downloaded 10 Nov 2026

name: RZD Logistics

Works with transport companies in Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Azerbaijan, Iran and Russia.
services: Multimodal / rail INSTC; customs clearance; terminal charges; wagon provision; sea freight FOB Bandar Abbas; location information / tracking language
portal: No public customer login found on the fetched INSTC page
sanctions_note: Not found as a named entry on OFAC SDN (9 Nov 2026 file). Persons and/or related Russian Railways entries appear on the EU Ukraine-related sanctions list. Check current status of the company and its parent before any commercial use, especially for EU persons.

services: Federation / professional standards; FIATA diploma training via national associations
portal: FIATA member area (not accessed)
